description: SSO-4120 — this application's PRODUCTION connection: who the production apply job (deploy.yml) is, and the two variables it reads in the GitHub environment `production`. It has the shape of a .thoryn/template.json connection and variable, so .thoryn/ci/login.sh and require-vars.sh read it (THORYN_TEMPLATE_FILE). It is kept out of template.json on purpose: template.json is what the creation flow sets up, and the production trust is not the creation flow's to create. The workspace's CONFIG project declares it (oauthy ADR 2026-10-25 decision 3, SSO-4079), pinned to this repository and its GitHub environment `production`. Until that trust exists and its clientId is set here, deploy.yml skips with a notice.

THORYN_PRODUCTION_WIF_CLIENT_ID.description: clientId (wi_...) of this repository's PRODUCTION workload identity trust, declared by the workspace's config project and pinned to this repository and its GitHub environment `production`.

THORYN_PRODUCTION_URL.description: The deployed application's https base URL, e.g. https://shop.example.com (no trailing slash). The production client's redirect URIs are <url>/callback and <url>/signed-out.

production.description: Who the production apply job is: the production trust. It creates this application's production client once, under a creation slot a workspace admin approves (oauthy ADR 2026-10-17), owns it, and converges it on every later run. Exactly the application ceiling of oauthy ADR 2026-10-25: no sandbox tool scope, no tenant scope.
